requirements.requirement: Changing data published after the origin leaves the earlier frozen forecast unchanged.
The scored target cannot appear inside a model context, scaler fit, gate feature, or analog retrieval.
Historical availability and live receipt policies are tested separately; imported archives are not rejected merely for being imported today.
First releases and revisions reconstruct different eligible snapshots at the appropriate times.
One-, five-, and twenty-session labels mature only after their complete intervals and publication rules.
Episode confirmation lags, existing episodes, and right censoring are represented correctly.
Cross-fitted event forecasts and upstream ensembles respect chronology and shared-event groups.
Forecast completion and source arrival times prevent fictitious earlier entries or earlier knowledge.
Reusing an examined holdout for a fresh confirmation claim is rejected by the experiment manifest.
Event probability, transmission probability, scenario mass, and expert weight have distinct typed fields.
Invalid conditional tables, non-normalized exclusive branches, and probabilities outside [0,1] fail validation.
Concurrent mechanisms are not normalized as though they were mutually exclusive outcomes.
Background B risk when A is absent is included in total probability calculations.
Predicted A cannot trigger the same update as independently observed/confirmed A.
Conflicting or unreliable observations do not silently create certainty.
Unknown dependence yields declared assumptions, bounds, or an unsupported result—not silent independence.
User assumptions and interventions remain separate from observations and conditional sensitivities.
Intervals over parameters and Monte Carlo error are not mislabeled as predictive outcome intervals.
Three independent 30% precursors produce P(any A)=0.657 in the reference graph.
The independent complete-set and A-and-B arithmetic in Section 10.3 matches exact enumeration.
Three perfectly coincident 30% triggers produce 0.30, not 0.657.
Three mutually exclusive 30% triggers produce 0.90.
A shared downstream B under the specified assumptions produces 0.55845 and is counted once.
Two conditional 85% marginals preserve joint bounds [0.70,0.85] without an independence assumption.
Both B-and-C and either B-or-C queries are distinct and independently tested.
Duplicating or renaming a source/scenario does not increase world probability or coverage.
AND interactions, inhibitory/buffering paths, mutually exclusive branches, and lagged feedback behave as declared.
Cancelled, postponed, expired, and non-propagating precursors update the correct future windows.
Sampled market episodes and derived variance paths cannot contradict each other in a joint-capable artifact.
Pruning/importance sampling preserves no-event and remainder mass with correct weights and uncertainty.
Identical point experts can retain nonzero predictive uncertainty through their outcome distributions.
Quantiles are ordered with valid support; sparse quantiles cannot silently imply full tails or joint paths.
A CDF mixture and a weighted-quantile average are distinguished on a known counterexample.
The empirical/analytic mixture CRPS identity matches a direct reference calculation.
Variance is nonnegative; cumulative variance equals path sums; annualized volatility is not forced monotone.
Marginal-only adapters cannot serve duration, joint-tail, or simultaneous multi-market queries.
A joint mixture preserves world/expert identity and shared dependence across its full path.
Unsupported/infinite required moments block the relevant score or payoff consumer with a specific reason.
Point/mean return-variance baselines do not silently masquerade as full intraday realized-variance distributions.
Independent calibration heads cannot be combined into an unverified coherent joint probability.
Equal/global/rolling/feature/event-stage policies can be evaluated on the identical forecast pool.
Post-inference features cannot be used to claim pre-inference cost savings.
Feature and gate parameters are fitted only on eligible earlier observations and out-of-fold forecasts.
Loss-to-weight, FFORMA-inspired surrogate, and direct-mixture objectives have explicit distinct identifiers.
An unconditional expert is not multiplied by scenario probabilities twice.
An unsupported expert cannot be represented as a conditional-world forecaster.
An expert failure is credited to its named fallback, not the failed model.
A scenario change invalidates affected cache entries even when price history is unchanged.
Consensus or simulated ensemble medians cannot enter real performance updates.
Rare-context shrinkage and bounded weight updates are verified against their declared policy.
Event outcome rules are frozen independently of the observed market response.
Storage/macro first-release timing, original weather runs, and publication-lagged data obey their vintages.
A forecast future covariate is marginalized through scenarios rather than treated as a certain observation.
Own-model error is not relabeled market surprise without an eligible expectation source.
Event occurrence, information receipt, and market response can have different clocks.
Non-occurrence, cancellation, and uncertainty resolution remain possible outcomes.
An ESS graph and a plain numerical comparator receive matched eligible evidence.
Unobserved downstream response is distinguished from delayed or missing reporting.
A zero external-call budget produces no paid API call or implicit paid fallback.
Concurrent reservations, retries, cancellation, and failures cannot exceed the configured budget.
Capability and license ineligibility removes an expert before dispatch.
Selecting more monitors changes coverage, not the underlying event probabilities.
The coverage planner handles shared outcomes/common drivers and is compared with exact small-set enumeration.
Disabled networking, expired deadlines, and action limits produce explicit stop states.
Acquisition scoring uses a same-time, same-future-target control rather than crediting elapsed time.
Off-policy learning records supported action propensities and does not invent unobserved counterfactual rewards.
Actual matured observations, simulated outcomes, critic scores, and assumptions are isolated in storage.
Every approved online update records its algorithm, training label IDs, and resulting state version.
Graph/model/prompt structural changes run in shadow until promotion approval.
A learner cannot change evaluation targets, splits, budgets, permissions, or entitlements.
Paired contribution credit is distinct from coalition success and model standalone accuracy.
Corrected outcomes produce a versioned correction/replay rather than silent history changes.
Rollback restores the declared model, gate, calibrator, graph, and online state.
An inconclusive or negative benchmark preserves the incumbent and cannot become a superiority badge.
Variance units, annualization, session coverage, estimator identity, and proxy labels remain consistent.
Missing intraday bars and stale observations are not interpreted as zero variance.
Splits and futures rolls do not create unmarked economic jumps.
Nonpositive commodity prices use an explicit valid target or unsupported status, not silent log clipping.
Paper replication and application-specific targets/horizons have separate task IDs.
Raw restricted datasets and model artifacts cannot be exported under the code license alone.
Pretraining overlap/unknown-cutoff limitations are retained in research reports and prospective gates.
Every numerical card exposes its target, conditioning, horizon, version, and synthetic/research/live status.
The graph editor changes validated numerical assumptions and creates a new branch, not merely a visual edge.
Empty, failed, unavailable, and unsupported states are visible without invented probabilities.
Coverage is labeled as research/monitoring coverage rather than profit probability.
Arbitration displays show actual run/failure/weight/cost lineage, not arbitrary model confidence.
All mandatory workflows can be reproduced through the CLI and inspected in the workbench.
Clean offline setup and a full synthetic vertical slice run without model downloads or external accounts.
Save/reload parity includes all fitted numerical and state artifacts, not configuration alone.
Idempotent replay/job recovery creates no duplicate evidence, forecasts, charges, or outcomes.
Graph text, retrieved documents, and serialized data cannot execute arbitrary code.
Credentials and private donor data are excluded from logs, artifacts, and the new repository.
Model/data licenses and capabilities are pinned and enforced independently.
CPU/reference and any accelerator paths have measured parity/resource tests with honest unsupported states.
Release reports distinguish tests run, failed, blocked, synthetic-only, and not implemented.
A high-variance path ending at the strike can lose the entire unhedged straddle premium.
Payoff calculations use contract-specific multiplier, expiry, exercise/settlement, and eligible underlying prices.
Entry/exit timing, bid/ask costs, financing where material, overlapping capital, and non-activations are retained.
Missing quotes return NOT_ASSESSED; model valuations are never relabeled observed historical fills.
No brokerage credentials, execution endpoint, or autonomous trade action exists.
The canonical goal is GOAL_UPD.md; all active entry points agree and archived specifications remain identifiable.
Purpose, allowlist, timeout, reservation and completion controls exist before any external model/source call.
A blocked external checkpoint cannot prevent a verified offline classical slice or be credited as tested.
The first scored offline slice includes genuine baseline inference, sealed predictions, matured outcomes and proper scores.
Numeric exponent overflow and nested nonfinite values fail safe serialization and contract validation.
Student-t and every admitted family reject invalid scale, parameter sets, support and required moments.
Nonexistent snapshot/model/calibrator references and missing or mismatched artifacts fail runtime integrity checks.
Synthetic lineage propagates through mixed inputs and cannot be cleared by a forecast, branch or export.
A monitor declares observation coverage, cadence, arrival/error/failure law and costs separately from event occurrence.
Coverage credits only eligible usable alerts satisfying the frozen lead-time rule; late and failed alerts remain visible.
Monitoring utility units, cost tradeoffs, candidate universe and constraints freeze before policy evaluation.
Duplicate feeds may change detection resilience but cannot create independent precursor or outcome probability.
Physical state, evidence/confirmation state and per-instrument propagation state are stored independently.
Query episode deduplication and cross-origin evaluation clustering preserve each origin-specific target definition.
An unrun expert has no realized counterfactual forecast score; missing forecasts never become zero loss.
Full-pool audit forecasts and randomized selection propensities are recorded with their full compute/acquisition cost.
Failure in a conditional branch cannot silently discard its probability mass or renormalize background risk away.
Event/world probabilities remain independently resolvable and scored; expert weights cannot masquerade as event calibration.
Scaffold/package checks and application acceptance execution have separate counts and no unimplemented capability receives a pass.
The real event study verifies intersecting contract/target/weather-run/member/availability coverage before confirmatory evaluation.
